item.title: Mobile Subscription Site with Telegram Integration: Irish League Edge
item.description:
350-780 GBP | I’m bringing Irish League Edge (ILE) online and need someone to put every moving part in place for a seamless, mobile-first subscription business. The core of the project is subscription services and, above all, automated member access. Once a fan joins ILE+ and the payment processes, they should receive instant access to our private paid Telegram channel, while also keeping the open, free channel available to everyone. On expiry or cancellation, their paid-channel privileges must be revoked automatically—no manual workarounds.
Here’s the full picture of what I expect you to deliver:
• Mobile-optimised website built from the ground up, ready for high traffic. • Secure, recurring payment flow (monthly and annual plans) that talks directly to Telegram to grant or remove access without delay. • Dual Telegram setup: public free channel plus invitation-only paid channel, both managed through the site’s back-end. • Self-serve customer dashboard so subscribers can upgrade, downgrade, pause or cancel at will. • Complete hosting and domain configuration, SSL, basic hardening and ongoing analytics so I can track growth and churn. • Admin panel with role permissions, content management and detailed subscription reporting. • Automated emails/notifications for sign-up, renewal, failed payment and cancellation events. • End-to-end testing, security checks and clear hand-off of all source code and documentation.
I’m happy to hear your preferred tech stack—whether you lean toward WordPress + Woo/Stripe plugins, a Laravel build, or a JAMstack approach—as long as it meets the requirements above, is future-proof and easy for a non-technical editor to operate.
Acceptance criteria: 1. A new user can subscribe, pay, and see themselves added to the paid Telegram channel in under two minutes. 2. Cancelling or an expired card removes them from that channel within five minutes. 3. Admin area shows real-time subscriber counts and revenue. 4. Site scores 90+ on Google Lighthouse mobile performance. 5. All credentials, repos and walkthrough docs are transferred before final sign-off.
If this sounds straightforward to you and you have past examples of similar payment-to-Telegram automations, let’s talk timelines and milestones.

item.title: Elegant Herbal Salon Website Build
item.description:
1500-3000 USD | I need an elegant, sophisticated website that immediately tells visitors they have found a purely herbal, chemical-free salon and spa. The first job of the site is to inform: every treatment and ritual we offer must be showcased through detailed service descriptions, complemented by real customer testimonials and a short, friendly questionnaire that helps guests understand their body, hair or skin situation before they ever step through our doors.
Once visitors feel confident in what we do, they should be able to book an appointment right there—desktop or mobile—through a friction-free calendar that syncs with our in-house schedule. Only after that primary flow should they see the option to purchase our take-home herbal products; a lightweight shop module or plug-in is fine as long as it never overshadows the service information.
The aesthetic needs to feel spa-luxury without losing its earthy roots: refined typography, a muted natural palette, high-quality imagery of fresh herbs and treatment rooms, subtle transitions—not flashy animations. I’m happy with WordPress, Webflow or a comparable CMS as long as I can update text, images and prices myself. SEO basics, fast load times, and secure hosting round out the technical expectations.
Additionally, the website must prioritize exceptional UX design and seamless integration with Square APIs for POS functionality.
Deliverables • Fully responsive website aligned with the elegant-herbal brand • Content setup: service descriptions, customer testimonials, interactive questionnaire • Integrated appointment-booking system synced to our calendar • Secondary product-ordering section, activated only after service details • Admin panel walk-through and 30-day post-launch support
Acceptance criteria: pages load in under 3 seconds on 4G, bookings reach our email and calendar without error, questionnaire stores results to a simple dashboard or sends them by email, product cart stays hidden until a visitor has viewed service content, and Square API integration functions flawlessly.

item.title: Small Engine Repair E-Commerce Website
item.description:
250-750 CAD | I need a fully-responsive website for my small-engine repair shop that doubles as an online parts store with several thousand SKUs. The build has to be portable: I want to drop it straight into Wix today, but also move it over to Squarespace later without having to rebuild the core code or the database.
Core pages • Home – a clean landing page that introduces the shop, showcases featured parts, and directs visitors to the store or lookup tool. • Online Store – catalog listing thousands of items, tied to a secure checkout and real-time inventory. • Parts Lookup – a custom search tool that lets customers drill down by make, model, engine, category, or exact part number. Speed and accuracy matter here; I’d like predictive text or auto-complete if feasible.
Key requirements • Simple to edit: drag-and-drop or WYSIWYG updates inside Wix, and the same content transferable to Squarespace. • Bulk inventory import (CSV or similar) plus an easy way to append new SKUs. • Clean SEO structure, schema markup for products, and fast load times. • Mobile-first design that retains full lookup functionality on phones.
Deliverables 1. Complete site files and theme assets ready to upload into Wix and Squarespace. 2. Fully functioning parts lookup module (search by make/model/engine/category/part number). 3. Documentation showing me how to add parts, edit pages, and migrate to Squarespace. 4. One short recorded walkthrough so I can see the admin flow in real time.
I’ll supply branding, product spreadsheets, and any API keys you recommend for payments or inventory sync the moment we start. If you have prior experience building heavy-catalog e-commerce on Wix or Squarespace, please mention it along with links to live examples.

item.title: Custom Real Estate Operating System & CRM
item.description:
750-1500 USD | We are looking for an experienced developer or small development team to build a custom operating system and CRM for a real estate/property management business.
The platform will support: - Short-term rentals - Long-term rentals - Property sales - Property management - Owners and clients - Guests and tenants - Vendors and cleaners - Maintenance - Leads and sales - Property onboarding - Client/vendor/team onboarding - Documents and contracts - Tasks, workflows, reporting, and dashboards
We are open to using existing platforms, frameworks, APIs, and third-party tools where appropriate, but the final system should be customized around our operations.
Key integrations may include: - Hostaway - PriceLabs - Airbnb / VRBO - Gmail / Google Drive / Google Calendar - Slack - Dialpad - QuickBooks - Stripe - DocuSign - Ring - Schlage - NoiseAware - Forewarn - Zillow / HAR / MLS - Other APIs as needed
The system should include strong workflow automation. Examples: - Reservation confirmed → create operational tasks - Checkout → create cleaning workflow - Cleaner completes task → trigger inspection/validation - Maintenance issue → assign vendor and track status - New property → start onboarding workflow - New client/vendor → start onboarding workflow - New lead → create follow-up tasks
We also want AI features such as: - Internal AI assistant - AI search across company data - Email/SMS drafting - Conversation summaries - Email and issue classification - Automated task creation - Maintenance issue analysis - Vendor recommendations - Lead qualification - Owner reporting - AI agents that can perform approved actions
The platform should support role-based access for: - Management - Property managers - VAs/staff - Cleaners - Vendors - Owners/clients - Sales/realtor staff - Accounting - Admins
We also want the architecture to support external portals such as: - Owner portal - Vendor portal - Cleaner portal - Tenant portal - Guest portal
The system should work well on desktop and mobile. A responsive web app is acceptable initially, but the architecture should support mobile apps later.
We are not requiring a specific technology stack. You may recommend the best approach. Experience with technologies such as React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, APIs, webhooks, automation platforms, OpenAI, Claude, or similar tools is a plus.
What matters most to us: - Strong UI/UX - Ability to understand business operations and translate them into software - Workflow automation experience - API/integration experience - Clean, scalable, maintainable development
Property management experience is helpful but not required if you are technically strong. When applying, please include: - Short introduction - Portfolio/examples of CRM, SaaS, automation, or AI systems you have built - Relevant experience - Technologies you work with - Availability - Whether you are an individual, team, or agency - Estimated pricing structure or rate - Your recommended technical approach for this project
Please start your proposal with PROPERTY OS so we know you read the full description. We are open to project-based, or ongoing arrangements. Budget will be discussed with qualified candidates.

item.title: Multipurpose AI Development with n8n Integration

* Shopify e-commerce store. * Easyship shipping and fulfilment. * Supplier APIs and additional business tools as required.

Experience required in:
* OpenAI API and Mistral AI. * n8n and AI agent development. * REST APIs, webhooks and integrations. * Docker, Ubuntu and self-hosted applications. * Shopify API integration.
